content: VMAF (Netflix) via ffmpeg libvmaf filter: pool methods min/harmonic_mean/mean(default); harmonic mean recommended to avoid a high mean masking a 1-second glitches, especially for streaming. Model defaults to version=vmaf_v0.6.1 and must be explicit/pinned since unpinned models make scores incomparable across runs. log_fmt=json gives a frames[] array (per-frame score) plus pooled_metrics summary (mean/harmonic_mean/min/max). Confidence-interval overlap between two scores means no statistically significant winner.
